review_evidence: The upstream GitHub checkout is no longer directly cloneable, so the exact frozen primary snapshot was recovered from the already-published Zoekt shard using the public search API with Whole=true. All 32 recovered Lean files matched the frozen repository-review manifest SHA-256 values byte-for-byte (32/32). Reservoir independently identifies commit 21bc93d as OrdvecFormalization 0.1.0, matching the frozen source revision 21bc93de82c328571e489533567f3f11f76c3d1c.

The complete 32-file primary snapshot was scanned and inspected by role. It is a theorem-rich formalization of finite Bayes decision/threshold optimality, quotient sufficiency and search, FNCH/hypergeometric overlap models, bitmap calibration/symmetry/null laws, and profile/refinement kernels; 28 files contain ordinary definitions/theorems/structures and substantive statements.

OrdvecFormalization.lean is the aggregate navigation root and remains retained. Examples.lean contains concrete formal parameters and proved example facts; Verify.lean and VerifyMovedImports.lean encode public-API and moved-name compatibility checks over the formal library and remain retained under the audit/navigation preservation policies. No source-local hard exclusion was established.
summary: Reviewed the exact pinned ordvec-formalization snapshot recovered byte-for-byte from the published shard; retain all 32 primary Lean files, including examples, API/compatibility checks and the navigation root.
